top_current_affairs.title: High-Level Committee Report on 'One Nation, One Election'
top_current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper II - Indian Constitution, Polity & Governance
top_current_affairs.summary: The High-Level Committee led by former President Ram Nath Kovind submitted its report recommending simultaneous elections to the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies as a first step.
key_upsc_relevance: Requires constitutional amendments to Articles 83, 172, and 356.
Proposes a two-phase implementation, including local body polls within 100 days of national polls.
Examines federal principles, Article 368 requirements, and logistical implications for the Election Commission.

top_current_affairs.title: Ecological Concerns Over the Great Nicobar Island Infrastructure Project
top_current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Environment, Biodiversity & Disaster Management
top_current_affairs.summary: Environmentalists and tribal rights groups have raised concerns regarding the strategic ₹72,000-crore megaproject involving a transshipment port, airport, and township on Great Nicobar Island.
key_upsc_relevance: Impact on the Leatherback sea turtle nesting sites and Shompen tribal community.
Compensatory afforestation policies and diversion of pristine rainforest habitat.
Strategic importance of the Malacca Strait vs. ecological conservation trade-offs.

top_current_affairs.title: RBI Transfer of Record Surplus Dividend to the Central Government
top_current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Indian Economy & Fiscal Policy
top_current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved a record surplus transfer to the Central Government under the Economic Capital Framework (ECF) recommended by the Bimal Jalan Committee.
key_upsc_relevance: Analysis of RBI's balance sheet and Contingency Risk Buffer (CRB) requirements.
Fiscal deficit target impact for FY25 and sovereign debt management.
Mechanism of central bank dividend transfers to fiscal accounts.

top_current_affairs.title: India's Push for the India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC)
top_current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper II - International Relations & Strategic Alliances
top_current_affairs.summary: Diplomatic efforts continue to operationalize the IMEC initiative amidst geopolitical tensions in West Asia, aiming to enhance trade connectivity between Asia, the Arabian Gulf, and Europe.
key_upsc_relevance: Comparison with China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).
Key multimodal routes including rail links, port developments, and clean energy pipelines.
Strategic significance for Indian trade routes bypassing the Suez Canal bottlenecks.

top_current_affairs.title: Implementation of the India Semiconductor Mission (ISM)
top_current_affairs.gs_paper: GS Paper III - Science & Technology and Industrial Growth
top_current_affairs.summary: Construction begins on multiple semiconductor fabrication plants and ATMP (Assembly, Testing, Marking, and Packaging) units approved under the ₹76,000-crore India Semiconductor Mission.
key_upsc_relevance: Global supply chain diversification and critical technology reliance.
Role of modified PLI schemes in high-tech manufacturing.
Key challenges: High capital expenditure, specialized raw materials (silicon wafers, ultra-pure water), and skilled workforce requirement.
